title: Rejection halts with a false output
statement: Let $z$ be a finite bit string, and start in any state $q$ with any valid input-head position, arbitrary two tape contents, both work heads at an arbitrary integer position $j$, and empty output. If the machine's transition on the scanned input symbol and the symbols under the work heads is the rejection action with input-head movement $i$, then after one step the machine is halted and its output is the one-bit string consisting of false.
hypotheses_covered: the transition at the given configuration equals the rejection action with movement $i$
